![Given nonradial outward gradient vector field](images/a5/a5ab7ab1e55a4c73fe75be5b4c82cab6ebec9404698487d510af7b5666c8160b.png)" :question/worked-solution "Level curves must cross the gradient vectors at right angles. Away from the axes, the arrows point more steeply upward or downward than radial arrows: near $(1,1)$ their direction is proportional to $(1,4)$, not $(1,1)$. Thus circles do not fit.

The matching curves are ellipses stretched horizontally. On their upper-right arcs the tangents slope gently downward, perpendicular to the steep upward-right arrows. Vertically stretched ellipses have the wrong tangent directions. The hyperbolas and parabolas also fail the perpendicularity check across the diagram.

$$
